title: Allow ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms in context-based ingress policies
body: Context-based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms. Databricks keeps their published IP ranges current, so you don't track the IPs yourself. Use these rules to allow hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, such as the Databricks Genie plugins for ChatGPT and Claude, to reach your workspace. See [Allow partner platforms in context-based ingress policies](/aws/en/security/network/front-end/partner-platforms).
